title: Man in Mirror
description: A man with short dark hair and a beard stands in a dark room and looks straight ahead while holding a smartphone in his right hand to take a picture of his reflection. The setting is dimly lit with deep shadows, a wooden floor, and a tall rectangular mirror or doorway with a faint glowing frame.
prompt: A man with short dark hair and a beard stands centered in a very dark room looking directly forward while holding a smartphone in his right hand to capture his own reflection. He wears a dark t-shirt. The scene is mostly black with deep shadows a wooden floor visible at the bottom and a tall rectangular mirror or doorway that has a faint glowing light along its frame.
